description: This source file defines a static internal class 'PngOpener' used for opening and parsing PNG images within the PDFsharp library. It contains methods for reading PNG streams, validating headers, processing chunks, handling CRCs, and decoding image data. It heavily interacts with PNG structure elements and related classes like 'Png', 'Palette', 'HeaderValidationResult', etc.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens and parses a PNG image stream with optional settings.

methods.name: HasValidHeader
methods.description: Validates the PNG header in the provided stream.

methods.name: TryReadChunkHeader
methods.description: Attempts to read the next PNG chunk header from the stream.

methods.name: ReadImageHeader
methods.description: Reads and returns the image header ('IHDR') chunk from the PNG stream.
